We’re a student-founded nonprofit sharing the joy of Pokémon cards with children through card donations and community outreach.

01 / Our Story

The best part of collecting?
Sharing it.

A favorite card can be the start of something special. The Kanto Project grew from a love of collecting and a simple idea: that joy is even better when it’s shared.

We collect Pokémon cards and share them with children, giving the cards we love a chance to become someone else’s favorite. Through card donations and community outreach, we’re bringing a little of that excitement to a new collection.
